items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] O’Neil. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah Hank O’Neil out of New York.

ctx.x: Wycliffe. So there are those. And I remember I was with Wild Bill Davison’s, I mean I never played with so many hotshot musicians in my life as the old Norway ship jazz parties with Hank and Shelly used to book the musicians.

Yeah Hank O’Neil out of New York. And we were playing this session, they wanted a jam session so we had Dizzy Gillespie and I forget he was a reed player, the tall younger guy, great, great player, Doc Cheatham, you know, who was better than a lot of people gave him credit for. I tuned in Johnny Carson or somebody one night and he’s sitting in with the band. And Dizzy was great. And we were just — but it seemed like there were more black players left over from the big band era. And I had a festival — several…
